cover.title: 5 niche signs your analytics is hiding why visitors leave

inner.title: blocked scripts
inner.body: in a 2021 test on one tech-heavy site, google analytics missed 58.67% of visitors, and 88.28% of firefox users. the people quickest to leave are the ones your dashboard never counted.

inner.title: declined cookies
inner.body: google says users who decline consent get no persistent id, so it can't tell 10 page views from 10 users or 1. its modeling only starts at 1,000 denied events a day for 7 days.

inner.title: one-page app blindness
inner.body: google says a single-page app without virtual page views is treated as one page, with all engagement time credited to the first load. you can't see time on any screen after that.

inner.title: split sessions
inner.body: without cross-domain measurement, google counts two users and two sessions when one person hops domains. every jump to a checkout domain looks like a stranger arriving.

inner.title: machine visitors
inner.body: cloudflare radar put bots at about 57.5% of html requests in june 2026, humans at 42.5%. that is request share, not visitors, but unfiltered machines still shape your funnel.
